scope: retain board-open retries when the initial local-to-server light-plugin mapping is unavailable
log unmapped server board and quest identifiers instead of silently dropping snapshots
verify retry registration precedes the mapping attempt
preserve live claim-state broadcasts and remove the local shadow posting on each connected client
checks: The one-shot Papyrus OpenBoard event is recorded before mapping. If mapping is unavailable, the client retries the mapping and Open request every two seconds until a complete snapshot is received.
Incoming server board/quest IDs that cannot be converted to local forms are reported once per connection, making dropped snapshot data diagnosable.
The source guard now fails if mapping is attempted before the board retry record exists or if incoming mapping failures become silent again.
The complete native patch is regenerated from the pinned upstream tree; a clean-tree patch application check is required before delivery.
The server broadcasts Taken to all peers; each client records state 1, and a visitor to that physical board polls every second and removes the local shadow letter for claimed/retired states.
limits: Windows/MSVC build and live two-client game test have not been rerun for this change.
